## Parent / origin

Migrated from Bead `FPL-761` (was **open**, priority 2).
Discovered from `FPL-2xu` (rank calibration contract).

## Status at migration

Open / owner-gated. Research found no defensible archived GW1–GW38 2025/26
overall-rank threshold source. Official Overall league (id 314) exposes current
paginated standings only. Public manager history and FPL-Core-Insights do not
supply the required historical global distribution. `FPL-2xu` therefore remains
**unavailable** for 2025/26 rather than inventing ranks. Prospective capture for
2026/27 is tracked separately (migrated from `FPL-762`).

## What

Identify one reproducible historical source for 2025/26 GW1–GW38 overall-rank
thresholds (or explicitly accept that history stays unavailable). Record
rights/retention, access/finalisation timestamps, field size and tie rule,
register the source, and produce immutable threshold artifacts. Do not scrape or
guess while unresolved.

## Files

- `control/sources/source-registry.yaml`
- `config/data_sources/historical-rank-thresholds.json`
- `data/benchmark-v0/rank-thresholds/2025-26/`
- `docs/data-sources/rank-thresholds.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source registry entry is complete and enabled only after owner approval — **or** owner records that no historical source will be approved and 2025/26 stays unavailable.
- [ ] If acquired: measured acquisition covers all 38 gameweeks or explicitly records unavailable gaps; every artifact has SHA-256 provenance.
- [ ] Rank calibration tests and season summary for `FPL-2xu` pass under the chosen outcome.

## Blocked by

Owner rights / acquisition decision. Related: prospective 2026/27 capture ticket.

## Non-goals

Scraping unapproved sources; inventing interpolated “exact” ranks; blocking core replay when rank evidence is unavailable.
